correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic the trace-zero centralizer of any nonzero X in sl₂ is its span: X is nonscalar and its full matrix centralizer is spanned by I and X. Thus a nonzero commuting pair is (αT,βT) in a unique projective direction. The determinant-one change (u,v)↦(t,w) in the proof preserves ω and reduces the vector condition to Tw=0. Each w≠0 gives q^(2n−1) choices of t for any scalar c, whereas w=0 contributes only at c=0. Exactly q+1 projective lines are nilpotent, each with q^n kernel vectors, and each has q²−1 coefficient pairs. Including the purely symplectic case X=Y=0 and the q² free center coordinates gives the stated N_c. The extra zero fiber consists of q^(2n+2) choices per commuting sl₂ pair, and the number of such pairs is q³+(q³−1)q. This checks ordered pairs, all nonzero c and all odd prime powers. Independent replay `python /workspace/branches/independent_math.py bracket` used ranks of adjoint matrices with and without their center row rather than the supplied pair loop. It reproduced the three recorded prime-field checks and found (N_0,N_c)=(52494561,4723920) for q=9,n=1; these are examples, not the general proof.
